title: Reproductive assurance can precede reduced floral attraction without causing it under pollinator isolation
primary_claim: In the delayed-selfing, assurance-cost 0.5, positive-mutation setting, reproductive assurance can precede floral-investment decline, but assurance evolution is not required for that decline.
independent_unit: 64 visitor histories; eight demographic repeats are nested
supporting_information: local-selection atlas and broad parameter grid
mutation/PDE diagnostics and unresolved high-resolution branch
exploratory attenuation of geographic divergence when assurance evolves
prohibited_claims: model distance or time is calibrated natural geography or evolutionary time
pollen deficit is interchangeable with viable fitness
submission_blockers: public DOI for prepared confirmatory raw-data deposit
insert DOI into Data Availability and preservation manifest
